rootCause: The battery is valid and no row moves; the design does not hold. Rev 2's authority is measurement (D-307), and three of the measurements it rests on are misstated against the tree and the installed packages: the delivered set DOES reach a caller on any write no repair fires inside (pending is seeded as a clone of triggered, so WriteRecord.triggered/DeleteRecord.triggered carry the fired listener handles and their binding addresses) — stated as a universal in §1, C-2 and H-3's Symptom, and used as the ground of the re-grain; the handle's re-mint after unlisten rests on index.d.ts:1219-1227, a clause superseded inside the same docblock at :1200-1211, so a re-listen answers the caller's own handle and the re-mint has no package ground; and the Record<ToolGroup,string> label table is in src/renderer/secure-panels.ts:165, not in src/main/operator-settings/index.ts as §1 says — contradicting §2 and S-10 of the same page. Four internal inconsistencies follow from the same cause of carrying a rule into one cell and not the one that measures or executes it: C-3 fixes the fan-out's prefix relation while §6's M-13 witness says each subscriber is notified only for its own address's delivery, and the two readings differ exactly on the leaf write the row drives; S-12 requires the ten-member set-equality rows to move while §2 says the bridge census is unmoved, and ISO-4's arm admits only 9 or 10; S-12 edits three operator-settings files that it names as rows and never as declared writes in another seat's scope, while OWED-6 gives the same precedent the full treatment for ipc-contract's types.ts; and S-17 claims exactly five nouns over a declaration spelling seven members. H-3's withdrawal, C-5's owner enumeration, the four-listener view crossing, the 26-row map with its four new rows and re-derived endpoints, and the battery's red-first discipline all survive the pass.
notes: Seven findings, all routed to the architect (the L1 design owner); none to the test writer. The battery holds on all four of examiner.md §2/§3's questions and no row moves. The findings, by subject: (1) the delivered-set universal is false on the clean arm — pending is seeded as a clone of triggered (`index.d.ts:962-994`), so a repair-free write's `triggered` carries the fired handles and binding addresses, and only a repair-fired delivery is the gap H-3's narrow reproduction names; H-3's withdrawal survives, the universal symptom does not; (2) C-3's re-mint after `unlisten` rests on a clause superseded at `index.d.ts:1200-1211` — a re-listen answers the caller's own handle — and `register`'s replacement rule is cited to the wrong site; (3) §1 attributes the `Record<ToolGroup,string>` label table to `src/main/operator-settings/index.ts` where it is `src/renderer/secure-panels.ts:165`, contradicting §2 and S-10; (4) §6's M-13 witness says each subscriber is notified only for its own address's delivery while C-3's prefix relation notifies a `['tabs']` subscriber of a leaf write under it — the two readings differ on the row's own stimulus; (5) S-12 moves the ten-member set-equality rows while §2 calls the bridge census unmoved, and ISO-4 admits only 9 or 10; (6) S-12's three operator-settings files are named as rows, not as declared writes in another seat's scope (D-301/D-302); (7) S-17's 'exactly five nouns' is contradicted by its own seven-member declaration. The corrected measurement (1) is L0's to record; the rest are the architect's re-derivation.
